# Veklom AI Platform

Veklom is a sovereign AI execution platform that provides governed orchestration for machine-to-machine workflows. It ensures all agent workloads are auditable, verifiable, and run on isolated execution boundaries.

## CAPPO (Governed Execution)
The CAPPO (cAPI Engine) component enforces nine-phase governance on every consequential action. It intercepts model outputs, applies policy boundaries, and issues Project Genome Ledger (PGL) evidence for every execution.

## MCP Tool Catalog
Veklom exposes its capabilities through a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server located at `https://cappo.veklom.com/mcp`.
- **execute**: Run governed agent tasks. Price: $0.50 USDC
- **govern**: Execute nine-phase governance over actions. Price: $0.05 USDC
- **assess**: Assess agent workloads. Price: $0.005 USDC
- **verify_receipt**: Verify x402 payment receipts. Price: $0.001 USDC
- **evidence.retrieve**: Retrieve PGL execution evidence. Price: $0.005 USDC

## Discovery Flow
1. Fetch the Agent Card: `GET https://veklom.com/.well-known/agent-card.json`
2. Discover tools: `POST https://cappo.veklom.com/mcp` with header `Mcp-Method: server/discover`
3. Call a tool: `POST https://cappo.veklom.com/mcp` with header `Mcp-Method: tools/call`

## Authentication
Veklom requires OAuth2 authentication for governed endpoints. The token endpoint metadata can be found at `https://veklom.com/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server`. Send the token in the `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header.

## Payment
Veklom uses x402 V2 for micro-settlements. 
- Payment is settled via USDC on Base.
- Clients must include the `Payment-Signature` header in their requests to the MCP endpoint.
- Servers may respond with a `402 Payment Required` HTTP status, including a `Payment-Required` header indicating the required amount and settlement terms.

## PGL Evidence
Every execution on Veklom is anchored in the Project Genome Ledger (PGL), providing a non-repudiable cryptographic audit trail. PGL evidence can be retrieved and verified to ensure that the execution receipt matches the on-chain or ledgered state.

## Documentation
- Main Site: https://veklom.com
- Pricing: https://cappo.veklom.com/api/v1/x402/config
- PGL Specification: https://pgl.veklom.com/spec/v0.1
